text: thats not it. i have seen the sign backwards for multiple builds now also why dont u just flip it? why do we have to prove anything at all that its one way or the other, i showed u its backwards, so just flip it
resolution: Per the user's directive to stop diagnosing and just flip it: the compiled (no-V8) game renders the street-name panel's letters horizontally mirrored on the sign's facing side, persistently across builds, while the editor (which renders street signs via a separate texture-capture panel) reads fine. Fixed by negating the X of the text boxes in streetSignParts (they are laid out centred on x=0 by textLineParts), so the baked stencil reads correctly in the compiled game. Scoped to streetSignParts only — leaves the editor texture path and blockLetters untouched. Rebaked clean (zig-out/game/hmsc.gamefile); user verifies on their next compiled build.
